title: Parts pages show the shared search and filter toolbar icons
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Parts pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Parts area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open any Parts list page (for example Inventory).
2. Look at the small icons on the right side of the toolbar.
expected: 1. The toolbar shows a Search (magnifier) icon and a filter (funnel) icon on every Parts list page.
2. Some pages also show a column/layout toggle icon (for example Inventory).
3. Behaviour to confirm — pending Branko's product write-up; to be checked live once the feature is available. (what the funnel and column icons do).
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11884-16885 (Parts filters); design-notes.md §B.5 shared shell
notes: Design-only (toolbar icon presence). Icon actions pending Branko's PRD.
